programme.desc: Marshal blir venn med en gåsunge kalt Fuzzy, men Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjelpe gåsungen å bli med flokken sin før de flyr sørover for vinteren. // Ryder og Paw Patrol må redde ordfører Goodway som tar av i en luftballong.

programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol redder en kattunge i bukta, men den lager masse kaos i byen, og de må redde den en gang, fra taket på rådhuset. // Katie og Cali sitter på et tog som står fast på grunn av steinskred. Ryder og Paw Patrol må rydde togsporet.

programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må finne igjen skolesekken som Alec har mistet før skolebussen kommer. // Chase har bursdag, men en storm fører til at strømmen går. Paw Patrol må fikse strømmen og redde bursdagsfesten for Chase.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene redder Cowboyfesten / Valpene redder Cali
programme.desc: Det er cowboyfest i byen, men når en flokk kuer rømmer fra togvognen, må Ryder og Paw Patrol redde festen. // Alex vil gjerne være med i Paw Patrol, men han ødelegger mer enn han hjelper til når de skal redde Cali fra låven til Yumi bonde.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Bukta / Valpene Redder en Goodway
programme.desc: En oljetanker har sprunget lekk i Adventure-bukta og Ryder og Paw Patrol må renske opp oljen. // Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjelpe ordfører Goodway med å få opp en berømt statue som har havnet i vannet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Sitter Tvillingvakt / Valpene Redder Fyrverkeriet
programme.desc: Ordfører Goodway ringer Paw Patrol for å få dem til å redde nevøen og niesen hennes ned fra et tre og for at de skal passe på tvillingene for en dag // Ordfører Goodway forventer en eske med fyrverkeri, men mottar en pakke med grisunger!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Hav-Valp

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Pizza / Valpene Redder Skye

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Pingvinene / Valpene Redder en Delfinunge

programme.title: iCarly: Rekordforsøket

programme.desc: Inkluderer sketsjer der Keegan og Jordan avlytter hvite kvinner som elsker svarte menn, Wendell lager en musikkvideo og Kareem og Jahar går på treningssenteret.

programme.desc: Artister blir sparket i skrittet på grunn av kunsten sin, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mann prøver å få hellet med seg på et møte for sexmisbrukere.

programme.desc: En gangster deltar i et skuddrama, en mor skriver en sang til sønnen sin, to bondefangere konkurrerer, Big Boi møter André 3000 og to karer kommer ut for en bilulykke.

programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan utforsker opplevelsen som sort collegestudent og snylterne som suksess medfører. Andre sketsjer inkluderer et nabolags reaksjon på et mystisk vesen, når man kan - og ikke kan - si et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Job Interview

programme.title: Key & Peele: Boarding Group One
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer at Keegan ikke får lov å gå om bord i flyet sitt, en bølle som nekter å helle ut innholdet i spritflaska og en bokser som sviner til modstanderen sin.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 304

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 305

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1304

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1305

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1306

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1307

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1301

programme.desc: Denne gangen går turen til Tannsjøen i Nord-Odal, der søstrene Kristine og Mari har tatt over en gammel tømmerhytte. Her blir gjengen utfordret på å bygge eget kjøkken, og ett soverom blir til to.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 604

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 605

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.desc: As a young couple is about to tie the knot, Johnny has a troubling vision of their future and must find a way to reveal what he sees.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Dasher, Riley, and Fosse
programme.desc: An Italian greyhound bites the hand that touches his toys; a 125-pound mastiff expands his grudge against the mailman; and a Yorkie has a shocking dislike of home appliances. Can Cesar help?

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Fondue, Chip, Hope & Joyjoy, and Elmer
programme.desc: A Hollywood couple had to turn down work because their French bulldog failed the Doggy Daycare entrance exam. Three Jack Russells began to fight each other when their owner got a serious boyfriend.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Bella & Big Boy, and Gracie
programme.desc: Marley and Me author John Grogan gets a new yellow Lab. Just like Marley, Gracie needs lessons in respect. Paul Frank Industries lets employees bring their dogs to work.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Woody & Wally, various dogs, and Kane
programme.desc: Cesar shows mail carriers in Roswell, Georgia, how to deal with close encounters of the four-legged kind. Next, Cesar meets a pair of Pomeranians that flip out when left alone.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Tori, Cassie & Skyler, and Tallulah, Bella, Boris, & Groucho, and Howie
programme.desc: An adopted miniature schnauzer compulsively spins in circles, four French bulldogs revolt against their owner, and an abused lab/chow/shepherd mix needs help accepting love.

programme.title: South Park: Gothbarn 3: posørenes daggry
programme.desc: Goth-ungene sendes på leir for problembarn.

programme.title: South Park: Freemium er ikke gratis
programme.desc: Stan blir avhengig av det nye mobilspillet med Terrance og Phillip.

programme.title: South Park: Heksesønner
programme.desc: På den årlige Halloween-sammenkomsten, kaster en heks trolldom som terroriserer alle i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Råtne tomater
programme.desc: Barna i South Park påstår at de har sett mr. Garrison luske rundt i byen. Folk i byen er sinte fordi presidenten skremmer barna deres.

programme.title: South Park: Sparkesyklene
programme.desc: Ungene planlegger å bruke siste nytt innen forflytning for å skaffe seg mer godteri til halloween enn de har fått noen gang.

programme.title: South Park: Tegridy Farms Halloween Special
programme.desc: Det er Halloween og Randy må forholde seg til datterens marihuanaproblem.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største drittsekk
programme.desc: Cartman føler seg ikke bra etter å ha drukket Kennys aske og blitt besatt av sjelen hans, og sendes til sykehuset.

programme.title: South Park: Helvete på jord 2006
programme.desc: Det er halloween, og Satan holder verdens største kostymefest.

programme.title: South Park: De levende hjemløses natt
programme.desc: Uteliggere oversvømmer South Park, og guttene legger en lur plan for å flytte dem til en annen by, mens de voksne får panikk.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Still Life/The Little People of Killany Woods/The Misfortune Cookie
programme.desc: Dan finds mystic photos in antique camera/Irishman's leprechaun tales turn real/Critic's end foretold by fortune cookies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Monsters!/A Small Talent for War/A Matter of Minutes
programme.desc: Young monster fan meets alleged vampire neighbor/Alien threatens humanity, nations rush disarmament/Couple finds empty street with strange workers.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare as a Child
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programme.desc: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
programme.desc: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Elevator/To See the Invisible Man/Tooth and Consequences
programme.desc: Brothers steal growth serum, find tasty web and giant plants/Chaplin invisible for emotional coldness/Dentist wishes to be loved, meets tooth fairy.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: I'll Give You A Million
programme.desc: Two old, rich men like to wager among themselves on trivial matters for huge amounts. One of them, Williams, offers his friend a million dollars for his immortal soul. Blaine accepts but discovers that he is dying of cancer.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Painkiller
programme.desc: Harvey goes to Dr. Roebuck with back pains and Roebuck prescribes a miraculous cure. It's not until later that Harvey finds the price he must pay...

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Odds
programme.desc: Tommy Vale, a barroom bookie finds himself in a curious predicament: a man comes in who can't lose. As the story unravels, he finds out that his opponent is Lacey, a man who went broke gambling with Vale in the past.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Mookie And Pookie
programme.desc: Twin siblings, Mookie and Pookie, are extremely close. But Mookie has a terminal illness. Later the scientific genius Mookie successfully downloads his mind into the computer before he dies.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Slippage
programme.desc: A young ad-design artist begins to literally "slip" out of reality. Slowly but surely he seems to be fading out of existence: first his payroll checks disappear, then his high school has no records of his existence.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Word Processor Of The Gods
programme.desc: Richard Hagstrom is dismayed with the way life has treated him (a rude son, a shrewish wife). His nephew Jonathan gives him a birthday present: a homemade word processor. Hagstrom soon discovers that anything he types into the processor becomes real.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: A Case Of The Stubborns
programme.desc: In a backwoods community, a family is plagued by their grandfather... who refuses to acknowledge that he's dead.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Djinn, No Chaser
programme.desc: A couple inadvertently buys a magic lamp that contains a genie. Unfortunately, the genie is anything but amiable. Confined in the lamp for thousands of years and still trapped, he refuses to grant wishes.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: All A Clone By The Telephone
programme.desc: Leon, a hapless TV writer, buys an answering machine that has a mind of its own - it initially helps him out by providing him with new material, but Leon soon finds that it's taking over his life.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: In The Cards
programme.desc: A fake fortuneteller, Caterina, finds herself stuck with a cursed deck of cards that foretell death for everyone she does a prediction for.

programme.title: Grantchester: Episode 401
programme.desc: Sidney Chambers deltar på et foredrag av pastor Nathaniel Todd, en sentral person i den amerikanske borgerrettighetsbevegelsen. Under arrangementet forstyrrer demonstranter Todds tale.

programme.title: Grantchester: Episode 402
programme.desc: Sidney finner ut at han var den siste personen som så en kvinne i live i løpet av en beruset natt. Geordie blir bekymret for vennen sin, mens Sidney sliter med å huske hva som skjedde.

programme.title: Grantchester: Episode 403
programme.desc: Geordie blir tilkalt for å etterforske det som tilsynelatende virker som et innbrudd i en datalab.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 416
programme.desc: Det er salgsdag, og Tess har det travelt med å registrere storfeet sitt slik at de kan få den beste prisen. Tess får god kontakt med en vennlig fremmed, Bree, uvitende om at Bree har noe i gjære.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 417
programme.desc: Megs søster, Celia Rivers, ankommer Drovers. Delvis bekymret, delvis spent – Meg alltid levd i skyggen av sin glamorøse, talentfulle, syngende søster.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 418
programme.desc: Meg forbereder hennes og Jodies avskjed, men oppdager at Jodi begynner å tvile.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Det blir humor, spenning og høyt volum i dagens duell. Med Leif Einar "Lothepus" Lothe, Fetisha Williams og hennes far Byron Williams på det røde laget, og Fritjof Wilborn, Trude Mostue og Egil Andreas Skurdal på det blå laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1105
programme.desc: Det er duket for to ekstremt sterke lag i dagens duell. Kampsport-gjengen med Emil Meek og Margaret Aase har med seg Lasse Matberg, og skal kjempe mot iskrigerne Colin Olsen, Jørgen Karterud og legenden Jan Tore Kjær.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1106
programme.desc: Det er to lag fulle av energi og sjarm som møter hverandre i dagens duell. På det røde laget finner vi Nate Khungu, Dennis Siva Lie og Sølje Bergman, som skal kjempe mot Grace Bullen, Morten Thorsen og Lene Alexandra.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1107
programme.desc: En gjeng gourmetkokker møter en gjeng fryktløse fartsfantomer. Christer Rødseth, Christoffer Davidsen og Trond Moi møter rallyfører Mads Østberg, artist Raylee og snøscooterkjører Marie Sandberg.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Det er lagspillere mot individualister som skal i duell. På det røde fotballaget møter vi Jan Gunnar Solli, Solveig Guldbrandsen og Tobias Becks. På det blå laget finner vi Rasmus Wold, Genette Våge og Victoria Tolaas.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Jeremy bygger en bil som er enda mindre enn den berømte Peel P50, og framlegger så konseptet for de fryktinngytende entreprenørene i Dragons' Den.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Top Gear-gutta prøver å gjenskape et tog med en bil som tauer en rekke campingvogner. Rowan Atkinson er ukens kjendis i en billigbil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy og James får i oppdrag å filme en informasjonsfilm om trygg sykling og må presentere den for et ekspertpanel.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Storbritannias fremste motorshow, med utfordringer, vurderinger og kjendisgjester.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond og James May hjelper flomrammede Storbritannia ved å bygge en luftputebil.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Soviet Steamroller
programme.desc: Their attack on the Soviet Union having failed, the German Army suffers a series of counter-offensives on the Eastern Front. Wehrmacht's losses are huge as the Soviets advance West.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Regis Philbin
programme.desc: Regis and Kim explore one of the most haunted places in America.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 5
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Scout Leader and Single mum of two; Debbie from South London, whose 2-bed flat is drowning in clutter and filth.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 6
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of American born dog loving Dani from Shepton Mallet who moved to the UK with high hopes of living the English Country dream, but bad health got the better of her.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 7
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Eco warrior Karen from Somerset, who after many years of living off grid in a caravan, has struggled to adapt to living in, and looking after, a house.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 8
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Pippa and Matt from Oxford who have 6 kids all living in a 3-bedroom house. With both parents working full time, the house has taken a back seat for many years.

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere: Episode 4
programme.desc: In Liverpool, the Bells are a family at war over hoarding. Mum Betty and son Richard are happy to live in their mess, but son in law Keith is determined that things must change. Can they change the habit of a lifetime and part with their possessions?

programme.title: Most Haunted: Hill House (Part 1)
programme.desc: Follow a desperate soul who draws the team ever deeper into this shadowy home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jerry Stiller, Mindy McCready, Nick Hogan, Lourdes Benedicto
programme.desc: Jerry Stiller receives a long awaited message from his father; a maternal figure appears to Mindy McCready at one of the darkest moments of her life.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters: War
programme.desc: War has been a constant in human history. All civilisations have grappled with the questions it raises. It is no surprise then that myths of war are among the most enduring.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Hospital on the Haunted Hill
programme.desc: Nick investigates a four-story hospital overlooking the city of Williamson, West Virginia that closed in 1988.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Mountain Clinic
programme.desc: Nick conducts the first-ever paranormal investigation of the Mountain Clinic, a 105-year-old vacant hospital.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 705
programme.desc: Pernille og Aron pendler den lange veien fra Odense til Kalundborg hver dag. Drømmen er å bo nærmere jobben, slik at de kan bruke fritiden på noe annet enn å sitte i bilen.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 706
programme.desc: Mie og Jakob har flyttet inn hos Jakobs mor for å spare til drømmehuset. Men er drømmehuset i det hele tatt på markedet? Tobias argumenterer for sin sak, og Mie og Jakob får seg et sjokk.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her parents told police that she was attacked and killed by wild dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Results Revealed: Did She Cheat?
programme.desc: Justin is convinced that girlfriend Lainie has been cheating on him, and more importantly that he’s not the father of their child. But his own insecurities have led him to turn violent. Also, Steven doubts whether Ashley’s child is his.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Tragic Accident
programme.desc: Rebecca left her baby with fiancé James and his mother Adeline, only to discover that her baby was hospitalized. Rebecca suspects that James is responsible. Adeline blames her for the baby’s death!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Starving Myself to Death
programme.desc: Pamela aims to weigh 40 pounds. Samantha, who suffers from bulimia and alcoholism, steals to accomplish her binging. Can both women confront their eating disorders with support and treatment?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Crawl to Your Wife
programme.desc: After surviving a wild car chase, losing her leg, and being comatose due to her husband, Portia will finally confront him. He won't admit fault, but today Steve’s helping Portia find her voice.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Teen Daughter Wants a Baby
programme.desc: 17-year-old Naomi has undergone a sudden attitude change and is on a mission to have a baby. Parents Leeanders and April need Steve to intervene!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Stole 15 Years of My Life
programme.desc: Jennifer left home to protect herself from her stepdad Allen. 15 years later, her mother wants a second chance, but Jennifer is hesitant. Can Steve help mend this broken family?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Timothy Peart’s Last Dance
programme.desc: When a teen is killed at a party, police question the guests and wonder if they’re all part of a cover-up.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Second Case
programme.desc: A woman’s mangled body is found beside a lonely stretch of highway. When the coroner suspects foul play, Kenda is called in to solve the second homicide case of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Master Key
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother and her two young sons are brutally slain, pressure mounts for the CSPD to catch the cold-blooded monster who did it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Settle the Score
programme.desc: When Johnny Crawford is killed in his easy chair, police are perplexed to learn he may have been shot over a musical instrument. It soon becomes clear the young man wasn’t killed for his own sins.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Everybody Lies
programme.desc: After church, deacon Robert Walton is beaten to death in a public park. The case heats up when Lt. Kenda and his team revisit an old friend with a secret. Did the religious leader have a dark side?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Things Come in Threes
programme.desc: When two young mothers are gunned down behind a crowded bar, Kenda has to first determine who was the intended target and who was collateral damage.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 502

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 507

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 505

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 607

programme.title: Henry Danger: Slosskampen
programme.desc: Når Charlotte blir utfordret til en slosskamp på skolen må Captain Man og Kid Danger hjelpe henne med å forsvare seg.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Steinboksdumpingen
programme.desc: Når en rapport som kommer ut konkluderer med at superkreftene til Kid Danger er en sykdom, må Kid Danger overbevise Solsyn om at det er en stor misforståelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fortidens Fremtid Del 1
programme.desc: Når Drex flykter gjennom Tidsportalen til Time Jerker, må Henry og Ray dra tilbake til fortiden for å stoppe ham, før han permanent endrer fortiden til Ray.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fortidens Fremtid Del 2
programme.desc: Når Drex forandrer unge Ray, må Henry, og nå destruktive, Ray, kjempe mot Drex og få Ray tilbake til normalen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Gummiand
programme.desc: Når Ray, ved et uhell, ødelegger den fjernstyrte bilen til faren til Henry, har de et manikyr/pedikyr-selskap for å tjene penger til å fikse den.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kutt i Budskjettet
programme.desc: Når viseordføreren kutter i budsjettet til Captain Man og Kid Danger for å bygge et høyhastighetstog, må Captain Man og Kid Danger finne kreative måter å spare penger på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tegneserien
programme.desc: Når Henry og Ray får en kopi av den nye Kid Danger og Captain Man tegneserien og ser at den er forferdelig, må de forte seg og fikse tegneserien før det store premiereselskapet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Biltur
programme.desc: Bursdagsbilturen til Charlotte for å se Bo Man Group opptre, blir utsatt på grunn av en 'Captain Man og Kid Danger'-nødsituasjon.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tommelkrig 1
programme.desc: Captain Man og Kid Danger blir sjalu når et ny gruppe kommer for å bekjempe kriminalitet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Bløffmaker
programme.desc: Når Ray treffer på eks-kjæresten, prøver han å imponere henne med og late som om Henry, Charlotte og Jasper er barna hans.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Problemet med Frittles
programme.desc: Når faren til Henry får tilbud om en ny jobb i Bordertown, prøver Henry og Ray å stoppe faren fra å få jobben, sånn at Henry ikke må flytte.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Pingvinene / Valpene Redder en Delfinunge
programme.desc: Noen har sveipet fisk av båten til Cap'n Turbot, så han kaller på Ryder og PAW Patrol som hjelper ham i etterforskningen. // Ved hjelp av sitt nye spion utstyr, inspiserer Chase båten og under dekk oppdager han en gruppe Pingviner.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Walinda / Valpene Redder et Stort Bein
programme.desc: Paw Patrol planlegger en spesiell feiring av Wally. Når han ikke kommer, må de finne hans spesielle venn Walinda. // Under Cap'n Turbots arkeologiske utgraving kommer et dinosaurbein til syne etter et steinras.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Elefantfamilie / Valpene og de Slemme Kattene
programme.desc: Valpenes kjøretur over savannen blir til en redningsaksjon og en familiegjenforening for en elefantfamilie. // Valpene må redde Adventure bukta fra de slemme kattene for å vinne en stor premie.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene lar Marshall Være Alene Hjemme / Valpene Redder Hjortefamilien
programme.desc: Når de andre valpene er på fallskjermtrening må Marshall få en gruppe med kattunger tilbake helt alene. // Ryder og PAW Patrol redder en hjortefamilie som sitter fast på den glatte isen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Venn / Valpene Redder en Blindpassasjer
programme.desc: Når Marshall bestemmer seg for å ta en pause fra Paw Control, slår valpene seg sammen for å få ham tilbake igjen. // Når Valpene finner en blindpassasjer på reisen til tundraen, må de redde en rømt kattunge i en rømt snowcat.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Den Nye Valpen
programme.desc: PAW Patrol rykker ut for å redde Jake når han blir strandet i isødet, men en ny valp dukker også opp for å gi en hjelpende pote: den modige Everest!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Bryllup / Valpene Redder Ace
programme.desc: Farmer Al og Farmer Yumi skal gifte seg! // Favoritt stuntpiloten til Skye, Ace Soarenson, er på vei til Adventure Bukta for å ha et fantastisk flyoppvisning. Like før ankomst får hun motorproblemer!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Papegøye / Valpene Redder Dronningbien
programme.desc: PAW Patrol drar ut i jungelen for å hjelpe vennen Carlos med å finne papegøyen Mateo som har blitt borte. // Ryder og PAW Patrol må hjelpe Cap'N Turbot å flytte bikubene over til et sted som er trygger for dem.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Voff og Roll-showet / Valpene Redder en ørn
programme.desc: Når en stor pop-stjerne kommer til byen, ødelegger en storm hele byen og scenen. Klarer Paw Patrol å redde dagen? // Mens de er i skogen redder valpene en ørn som sitter fast i reiret sitt.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene redder dykkerklokka / Valpene redder beverne
programme.desc: Mens Turbotene dykker, blir en av dykkerklokkene sittende fast. PAW Patrol må redde dem! // En storm vasker vekk beverdammen, så han tygger opp hele skogen til farmer Yumi. PAW Patrol kommer for å hjemmelaget ham med å bygge et nytt hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjensittingen
programme.desc: Sam må sitte igjen den kvelden iCarly holder sin 50. nettvideospesialsending. Carly og Freddie kan da altså ikke gjøre som de pleier, så de prøver så godt de kan å få gjennsitting de også, så de kan sende fra skolebenken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Fotsår reklame
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie blir invitert til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de blir tilbudt en stor pengesum får å gå god for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foten, på iCarly. Men det viser seg at skoene er forferdelige.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg lover å ikke sladre
programme.desc: Carly får en B på historieprøven hun burde ha fått en A på. Sam, som griper sjansen på sitt ukentlige møte med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på datamaskinen og overrasker henne med A blank.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly redder TV
programme.desc: En prestisjetung produsent vil gjøre iCarly om til et TV-show. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie blir raskt fortvilet når de hører om alle de store forandringene produsenten ønsker å foreta.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg hater Sams kjæreste
programme.desc: Sam får en kjæreste og de to blir uadskillelige. Men når forholdet begynner å få følger for iCarly, forstår Carly og Freddie at de må gjøre noe.

programme.title: iCarly: Overvåket
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett et klipp på iCarly der en mann selger illegale piratkopivideoer, bestemmer to detektiver seg for å bruke Carly og Spencers loft for overvåking.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolebytte
programme.desc: Carly får vite at hun får mulighet til å få et fullt stipend til en privat eliteskole pga nettshowet sitt. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i sterk tvil, men Sam og Freddie vet de må få henne til å gå for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en date
programme.desc: Når vennen deres Gibby er for sjenert for å be ut jenta han liker, bestemmer gjengen seg for å gjøre ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" innslag på nettvideoshowet deres

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween

programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Lise og Damien blir snart tobarnsforeldre og vil ut av bykjernen og ned på bakkeplan. Cecilia starter i ny jobb i Trondheim om to uker, men har ikke hatt tid til å gå på visninger.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Ole Jørgen og Gina er førstegangskjøpere på begrenset budsjett, og drømmer om en fredfull og landlig enebolig til seg og kattene. Oda og Simon har noen spesielle utfordringer med sin nåværende bolig.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 305
programme.desc: Det er en ny uke på Camp Kulinaris og det betyr ny meny og ny restaurantsjef. Det oppstår en konflikt i huset som blir en stor utfordring for den nye restaurantsjefen, og en ny deltaker kommer inn.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 306
programme.desc: Det er menysmaking på Camp Kulinaris og restaurantsjef Michael sliter med å få folk til kjøkkenet i tide. Han ser seg nødt til å ta grep som ikke blir bare godt mottatt hos alle.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 307
programme.desc: Det er serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. Deltakerne skal for første gang drifte en a la carte restaurant. Det skal vise seg å ikke være så lett og det oppstår ganske raskt totalt kaos på kjøkkenet.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 308
programme.desc: Det er konkurransedag på Camp Kulinaris, og en deltaker må reise hjem. Restaurantsjef Michael velger ut en førstelærling. Et valg som ikke blir godt mottatt av alle.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 309
programme.desc: Ny uke, ny meny og ny restaurantsjef på Camp Kulinaris. Det er knyttet stor spenning til hvem som blir ukas Restaurantsjef, og gruppa innser at de står foran en krevende uke.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 310
programme.desc: Det er menysmaking på Camp Kulinaris og Erlend Elias sin stadig uteblivelse fra kjøkkenet skaper stor irritasjon blant resten av gruppa. Johanna sliter med å holde konfliktnivået i gruppa nede.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Roger er tilbake på Gran Canaria etter en litt strevsom tur, og på hotellrommet oppstår det problemer med lysbryteren i år igjen. Familien Haider gjør comeback, men får en slitsom ankomst.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Familien fra Harstad er tilbake! Og for å slippe lastebiltrøbbel, har onkel Erling bestilt en sjåfør. Kai Thomas vil på stranda, men Aurora er mer opptatt av hundene sine.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Charter-Svein er tilbake, og med seg på lasset har han sine tre like energiske barn Noah, Liam og Ylva. Roger drar til havs for å fiske hai og har en opplevelsesrik tur på sjøen.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Buskeruddamene har landet og er klare for irish og strawberry. De må bare få permobil-lappen først. Det er onkel Erlings drømmedag og han har planlagt aktiviteter for gjengen de sikkert vil elske.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1305
programme.desc: Haider tar gladelig på seg rollen som Baywatch-stjerne da familien trenger opplæring i livredning. Rockeren Geir vil gjengjelde Fred Åges godhet og har planlagt en dag full av gaver og overraskelser.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1306
programme.desc: På Gran Canaria tar kjærligheten, vennskapet og små hverdagsdramaer uventede vendinger. Haider håper på en romantisk date med Neelam, Pondern og Mutza sliter med å mestre en nøkkelboks.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 606
programme.desc: I Trondheimsfjorden utenfor Råkvåg venter Harøya, en liten øyperle. Halvor har helt rå planer for den slitte låven. De skal bygge et mesanin og Ole har en vanvittig smart løsning for det unike spisebordet.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 607
programme.desc: Høyfjellsområdet Bjørnfjell utenfor Narvik bugner av fritidsaktiviteter, sommer som vinter. Gutta tar denne gangen for seg en godt brukt hjelpekorps-hytte som sårt trenger litt kjærlighet.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 608
programme.desc: I vakre Numedal, med utsikt over Uvdal ligger hytta til familien Bjerke. Halvor forvandler en typisk norsk seterhytte til en lun amerikansk lodge.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 609
programme.desc: Denne gangen er det fisk på menyen. På øya Frei utenfor Kristiansund møter vi familien Furseth og deres gamle klippfiskbrygge. Her får Halvor vist frem både kreativiteten og kokkekunnskapene sine.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 610
programme.desc: Ved innsjøen Tyin ligger hytta til Benedicte og Jon Olav idyllisk til. Denne gangen blir det store endringer både ute og inne, og gutta får prøvd seg på nye kreative løsninger og hemmelige rom.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 701
programme.desc: Gutta tar turen til idylliske Nesdal innerst i Lodalen, der de skal forvandle en storgård til et lunt sommersted. Halvor viser hvordan små grep kan gi stor forandring, og Ole får et byggeprosjekt nede ved vannet.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2303
programme.desc: Ida Helene fra Harestua klarer aldri å holde et budsjett og går i minus hver eneste måned. Bare ett år etter at hun kjøpte leiligheten hun og datteren bor i, står hun i fare for å miste den. Klarer Lene og Hallgeir å redde boligen?

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2305

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2306

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2307

programme.title: Fredag den 13.
programme.desc: Vi viser Fredagen den 13. del 2-8 filmene på denne kanalen i tillegg til nyinnspillingen fra 2009. Følg med for å se hva Jason Voorhees gjør best! Skrekken starter fra kl. 22.00 til tidlig morgen.

programme.title: Fredag den 13ende del 8: Jason inntar Manhattan
programme.desc: The Big Apple får problemer når den uødeleggelige galningen Jason Vorhees reiser til New York, og maler byen "rød".

programme.title: Friday the 13th - The TV series
programme.desc: En spenningsserie som handler om det overnaturlige. I hver episode begir fire modige sjeler seg ut på et oppdrag i fare og redsel når de sporer opp og henter tilbake forbannede gjenstander. Mysteriet starter fra kl. 20 hver kveld.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Playhouse
programme.desc: Two children trapped in an abusive home stumble upon a cursed playhouse. The playhouse lets them enter a fantastical world of clowns and parties in return for them luring in a child.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Tree Of Life
programme.desc: An exclusive fertility clinic is much more than it seems. It is run by a cult of female Druids who use a cursed fertility statue to expand their numbers.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: 13 O'clock
programme.desc: A cursed pocket watch lets its owner stop time for one hour, and a vicious pair of killers get hold of it.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Hate On Your Dial
programme.desc: Johnny sells a box of junk to a neighbour without checking the Manifest. A cursed antique car radio is among the items sold.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: And Now The News
programme.desc: In an insane asylum, a doctor is using a cursed antique radio to enact miraculous cures on his patients.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere: Episode 4
programme.desc: In Liverpool, the Bells are a family at war over hoarding. Mum Betty and son Richard are happy to live in their mess, but son in law Keith is determined that things must change. Can they change the habit of a lifetime and part with their possessions?

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere: Episode 5
programme.desc: In the London suburb of Enfield, former workaholic Sandra has become a hoard-aholic since retiring. Her compulsion to spend is out of control, and everything is added to the growing mountains of books, clothes and candles…

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere: Episode 6
programme.desc: In South Wales, 49-year-old Alison has always been a hoarder. What started as a passion for teddy bears has transformed into an obsession for. She currently has 11 and they rule the house, at least the bits they can get to in between the hoard…

programme.title: Ekstreme samlere: Episode 8
programme.desc: 79-year-old Joyce moved into her dream home in Liverpool nearly 40 years ago with her partner, Norman. But when he passed away, she lost her battle to keep on top of the hoarding behavior she inherited from her mum.

programme.title: Cube Zero
programme.desc: Åtte fremmede våkner i et merkelig, kubeformet rom uten å huske hvordan de havnet der.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Mountain Clinic
programme.desc: Nick conducts the first-ever paranormal investigation of the Mountain Clinic, a 105-year-old vacant hospital.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Melody Thomas Scott
programme.desc: Young and the Restless actress Melody Thomas Scott returns to the home in Sherman Oaks, California she fled decades ago after a face to face meeting with a desperate spirit.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Kristen Renton
programme.desc: Kristen Renton (Sons of Anarchy / Days of Our Lives) went on a ghost hunt aboard the Queen Mary, a docked ship in Long Beach, CA.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Johnathan Schaech
programme.desc: Actor Johnathon Schaech (That Thing You Do!, Texas Rising) anxiously returns to an old theater in Austin, Texas where he had a harrowing and life-changing paranormal experience. With psychic medium Kim Russo by his side.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Stole 15 Years of My Life
programme.desc: Jennifer left home to protect herself from her stepdad Allen. 15 years later, her mother wants a second chance, but Jennifer is hesitant. Can Steve help mend this broken family?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Is My Property
programme.desc: Lanikka is sick and tired of her boyfriend Malcom’s abusive ways. Then, Tim’s jealousy has torn his family apart, but now he’s desperate to win them back, but will Tiffany leave him for good?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Slept With THAT Man?
programme.desc: LaShawna and her boyfriend James will learn if her friend Coral harmed her child years ago. She’ll also admit that she cheated with Coral. How will he react when he finds out another bombshell?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Better Not Fail That Test!
programme.desc: Lainie and Justin have a 9-month-old baby together. Justin hurts Lainie because he thinks she’s cheating. But how will Steve react when he confronts Justin?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: How Could You Cover for Him?
programme.desc: Gina believes that her daughter’s boyfriend Efrain is abusing her grandson. Her daughter wants to prove that Efrain is innocent, but her father Raul suspects she is covering for Efrain.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?
programme.desc: Who’s responsible for toddler Noel's well-being? Everyone may deny the allegations, but someone knows what happened, and Steve is getting answers!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Things Come in Threes
programme.desc: When two young mothers are gunned down behind a crowded bar, Kenda has to first determine who was the intended target and who was collateral damage.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My, My, Merry Christmas
programme.desc: Donald Ott is found shot to death, friends tell police he didn’t have an enemy in the world. But when Lt. Joe Kenda speaks with family, he learns of a relative who might hold the key to the mystery.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Where is Claudia Jane
programme.desc: 15-year old CJ Bates is reported missing, and Kenda must investigate the mysterious circumstances behind the disappearance of the teenager.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Married To The Job
programme.desc: Sgt. Joe Kenda and his officers are facing off against a barricaded gunman when he gets an emergency call from his wife.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Six Feet Under
programme.desc: Kenda finds the body of a bruised and battered young woman named Vicki Ross strangled. Kenda must sort through the endless suspicious characters in Vicki's past to find the elusive truth.

programme.desc: In the early morning hours on a dark and cold day the forensic officer of the Police force is called out to a break in at a garage. A few hours later he is called out again, but this time there is a dead body, brutally murdered, lying on the pavement.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: African Beauty
programme.desc: A young and beautiful girl from Africa comes to Iceland with her sailor boyfriend and gets married. A few years later they divorce and she opens up a brothel in the centre of Reykjavík, literally next door to the main Police station.

programme.title: Cops: Check Please!
programme.desc: Deputies confront an intoxicated man who threatened a restaurant owner. A man tells officers he can assault who he wants. Officers are called to an altercation over a sleeping bag and a backpack.

programme.title: Cops: Decorating Tips

programme.title: Cops: A Man Without a Plan

programme.title: Cops: The Truth Is Key

programme.title: Cops: Mother Knows Best

programme.title: Cops: The Naked Truth
programme.desc: An evasive driver blames his girlfriend for his behavior, a pregnant woman makes some questionable choices, and a robbery suspect finds comfort in coming clean.

programme.title: Cops: Rock Star

programme.title: Cops: Window of Opportunity
programme.desc: Officers apprehend an armed suspect, the cops are called when a man damages his neighbor's window, and deputies investigate a parking garage known for illegal activity.

programme.desc: A suspect collides with another driver while fleeing from police, deputies mediate an altercation over a bag of chips, and officers respond to a domestic dispute.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Deathly Fatal Passion At the Hotel (Villermet case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Céline Marchand Case
programme.desc: On May 30th 2015 in Sorinières, Yann Machand reports his wife Céline Marchand missing.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker
programme.desc: En tidlig februarmorgen i Stockholm melder en mann sin kone, Sacha, savnet. Etter hvert som politiet graver i parets fortid, oppdager de et turbulent forhold under den tilsynelatende ryddige overflaten.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 204

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 403

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 604

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker
programme.desc: En ung mann blir funnet død på et jorde utenfor Enköping. Ved første øyekast ser det ut som om han har lagt seg ned for å hvile - men når politiet undersøker liket, oppdager de noe som antas å være et skuddsår.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Problemet med Frittles
programme.desc: Når faren til Henry får tilbud om en ny jobb i Bordertown, prøver Henry og Ray å stoppe faren fra å få jobben, sånn at Henry ikke må flytte.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Pjokken kommer
programme.desc: Når Pjokken tar kontroll over Man-grotta, må Charlotte og Jasper finne en måte å snike seg inn på for å redde Kid Danger og Captain Man.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Diamanter til Heather
programme.desc: Kid Danger og Captain Man er kalt ut til Swellviews museum for Krakker og Juveler for å forhindre at en sjelden diamant blir stjålet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Søte-Møtet
programme.desc: Henry og Ray prøver å hjelpe Piper med å fullføre et søte-møte med en ny gutt hun liker på skolen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Stavekonkurransen
programme.desc: Dr. Minyak utfordrer Captain man til en stavekonkurranse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Captain Man-kini
programme.desc: Når en ny internettkjendis lager kaos i Solsyn, må Captain Man bytte kropp med Frankini for å infiltrere den hemmelige hulen hans.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tommelkrig 2
programme.desc: Tommelkompisene kommer tilbake fra rommet og vil ta hevn på Captain Man og Kid Danger.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Opp trappene
programme.desc: Tommelkompisene kommer tilbake fra rommet og vil ta hevn på Captain Man og Kid Danger.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Flabber Gass
programme.desc: Etter å ha vært for selvsikre før en kamp, blir Kid Danger og Captain Man sprayet med Fabber gass. Det gjør at de ikke klarer å slåss mot den nye kjeltringen i Solsyn. Schwoz får heltene i noen drakter som Charlotte og Jasper kontrollerer.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Danger Things
programme.desc: Piper blir fanget av et vesen fra en annen dimensjon. Captain Man og Kid Danger må redde henne fra Farlig Forskning AS som har åpnet portalen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henrys bursdag
programme.desc: Mens han prøver å feire bursdagen sin, blir Henry forstyrret av kriminelle handlinger som pågår i Solsyn.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene redder dykkerklokka / Valpene redder beverne
programme.desc: Mens Turbotene dykker, blir en av dykkerklokkene sittende fast. PAW Patrol må redde dem! // En storm vasker vekk beverdammen, så han tygger opp hele skogen til farmer Yumi. PAW Patrol kommer for å hjemmelaget ham med å bygge et nytt hus.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Talentshow / Valpene Redder Maisfesten
programme.desc: Det er dagen for Adventure Bukta's Talentshow ! Ordfører Goodway er spent, men redd det ikke vil være nok fremføringer! // Ryder og Pups hjelper Farmer Al å forberede den årlige Maiskolbe-stekingen som blir komplett med en Maiskolbe-labyrint!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Romvesen / Valpene Redder en Flyvefrosk
programme.desc: Et romskip krasjlander hos Farmer Yumi! // Nå er det opp til PAW Patrol å hjelpe romvesenet ved å fikse skipet hans og få ham tilbake til hjemplaneten sin!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Jake / Valpene Redder Paraden
programme.desc: Jake og Chase er dypt inne i en hule når Jake klarer å sette fast ankelen mellom noen steiner // Adventure Bukta's Paradedag går galt når Alex fester for mange ballonger på badekar-flåten til Katie. Den bokstavelig talt 'flyter' bort!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Ordfører-konkurransen / Valpene Redder Tyvegodset
programme.desc: Det er det årlige ordfører-racet og Ordfører Humdinger legger planer for den verste juksingen noensinne // Når Ryder kommer over et gammelt skattekart, stjeler Ordfører Humdinger kartet for å finne skatten selv.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Grynterne / Valpene og Spøkelseshytta
programme.desc: En sykedag hos Paw Patrol? Mens Rubbel og Ryder leter etter grisene til Al, må Marshall passe på de snufsete valpene // Først forsvinner lunchen til Rubbel, så er lunch-boksen til Jake borte. Er det et spøkelse?

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Bjeffer med Dinosaurer
programme.desc: Valpene er på en utgraving når de graver ut tre fossile egg. Plutselig begynner eggene å klekke og snart er det tre pterodactyler som løper rundt i Adventure Bukta. Nå er det opp til Paw Patrol å fange dinosaurene.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Spøkelse / Valpene Redder en Forestilling
programme.desc: Et mystisk spøkelse forårsaker kaos om natten. Valpene og Chase sitter på vakt for å fange det, men oppdager at det ikke er et spøkelse i det hele tatt. // Valpene skal sette opp på et Middelalderskuespill i bytorget, men så kollapser scenen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Flyndra og Francois / Valpene Redder Pingvinene
programme.desc: Cap'n Turbot og Francois er ute og ser etter hvaler når Flyndra treffer en stein og begynner å synke. Denne redningsaksjonen krever alle labber på dekk. // Pop-up pingviner er plassert over hele Adventure Bukta. På tide å ringe Paw Patrol!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Snøbrett-konkurranse / Valpene Redder en Høne til Sjøs
programme.desc: Jake og Everest gleder seg til snøbrett-konkurransen inntil de ser at hele løypa er dekket av snø. // Når Paw Patrol drar for å finne dykkerklokken til Cap'n Turbot som har sunket, møter de en gigantisk sjøsnegle.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Speidertur / Valpene Redder en Overraskelse
programme.desc: Marshall og Paw Patrol hjelper Alex med å lære om brannsikkerhet mens de er på campingtur. // Det ser ut til å være en vanlig dag i Adventure Bukta når Paw Patrol blir kalt ut på et oppdrag. Men Valpene får seg litt av en overraskelse!

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack rat
programme.desc: Carly må trå til når Spencer blir avhengig av et videospil. Sam lurer Freddie til å tro at han blir forfulgt av uhell når han nekter å sende et kjedebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skylder deg en
programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dobbelt opp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniker seg ut for å dra til en MMA-kamp, får de sine dobbeltgjengere til å lure Spencer til å tro at de fortsatt er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kjempeversjon av Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Om hva for noe?
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie oppfordrer iCarly-fans til å stemme på David Archuleta i "Amerika Sings", syns de synd på nummer to og hjelper ham med å lage en musikkvideo.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Skåne

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Sjuhärad

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Greater Copenhagen

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Höganäs

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Karlstad

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Shag Pad Invasion

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Over the Edge

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed 5 Times?
